gloss: night of the full moon; harvest moon

definitions.gloss: night of the full moon; harvest moon
definitions.explanation: The fifteenth night of the eighth month in the traditional lunar calendar, celebrated as a moon-viewing occasion. By extension, the full moon itself.

examples.japanese: {十五夜|じゅうごや}の{月|つき}がきれいだ。
{十五夜|じゅうごや}には{団子|だんご}を{供|そな}えて{月見|つきみ}をする。
examples.english: On the night of the harvest moon, we offer dango and view the moon.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}たちが{十五夜|じゅうごや}の{歌|うた}を{歌|うた}いながら、{家|いえ}の{庭|にわ}で{月|つき}を{眺|なが}めていた。
examples.english: The children were gazing at the moon in the garden while singing harvest moon songs.

notes:
Literally "fifteenth night," referring to the fifteenth night of the eighth lunar month (around mid-September to early October in the modern calendar). This is the most important moon-viewing ({月見|つきみ}) occasion in Japan, also called {中秋|ちゅうしゅう}の{名月|めいげつ} (harvest moon of mid-autumn).

Traditional customs include displaying {月見団子|つきみだんご} (moon-viewing dumplings), {薄|すすき} (pampas grass), and seasonal offerings. The image of a rabbit pounding rice cakes on the moon ({月|つき}のうさぎ) is strongly associated with this night.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {十五夜|じゅうごや}の{月|つき}: the harvest moon
- {十五夜|じゅうごや}の{月見|つきみ}: harvest moon viewing
- {十五夜|じゅうごや}に{団子|だんご}を{供|そな}える: to offer dango on the harvest moon night

RELATED WORDS:
- {月見|つきみ}: moon viewing
- {中秋|ちゅうしゅう}の{名月|めいげつ}: harvest moon of mid-autumn
- {十三夜|じゅうさんや}: the thirteenth night — the second most important moon-viewing occasion
